cases.assertion: candidate policy exposes daily_usd and monthly_usd without changing old clients
usage at UTC midnight belongs to the new day
usage at the first UTC day of a month belongs to the new month
concurrent reservations cannot collectively exceed the tenant limit
one tenant reaching its limit does not consume another tenant's budget
a new model call at or above the limit returns tenant_budget_exceeded
new Task admission can reject a tenant whose model budget is exhausted
direct gateway calls cannot bypass task admission
an in-flight call is settled once when final usage arrives
errors and metrics contain limits and usage but no provider secret
the contract names one authoritative usage store instead of a Worker shadow ledger
meter availability failure has an explicit reviewed transient policy
deployment seed supplies the approved free-tier daily and monthly defaults
